observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 94.» (L16) and «p. 95.» (L21, beside the head of the chapter) in the right margin. The count of the lines runs on through the space before the head of chapter 31 and through the head: 25 stands beside the title of the chapter, 30 beside L26.
body L5: the s of «hemisphaerii» is printed broken, only its upper half and a short stroke; the word is complete.
body L21, L22: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type: «CAPUT XXXI.» in capitals about 9.7 pt high, the title about 14 pt; both are centred.
notes_left L4: the dash follows the full stop after «capitis» without a space.
notes_right L8: الضو is printed without the hamza of الضوء (light); kept as printed.
notes_right L9: a light speck stands after «legit», before the Arabic word; it is not a sign.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
